newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price averaged $20.29 a barrel in 1996.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price averaged $20.29 a barrel in 1996.

text.p: The price of the OPEC basket of seven crudes averaged $20.29 a barrel for the whole of 1996, compared with $16.86 the previous year, the OPECNA news agency said on Tuesday.
Quoting figures released by the OPEC Secretariat in Vienna, it said the basket averaged $23.51 in December, against $22.23 in November and $23.28 in October.
For the fourth quarter of 1996, the price of the basket averaged $23.06 a barrel, as against $20.23 in the third quarter.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
